title: Rating Standing Applied to the Premium of a Repriced Protection Plan
content:
The rate at which the premium of a Pass and Trip Protection plan is worked out afresh, when the plan's covered
value is brought onto the price the covered holding's own record shows, answers to the standing of the covered
holding's account under the Season Pass Programme and to the standing of the plan itself.

**The rating schedule.**

| Standing | Rate the premium is worked out at |
| --- | --- |
| The covered holding's account carries an instalment the payment method refused in the season, and the plan does not stand out of force for non-payment | The plan's own rate of the value covered raised by 1.00 percentage point |
| The covered holding's account carries no refused instalment in the season, and no payout stands on the plan for the season | The plan's own rate of the value covered lowered by 0.75 of a percentage point |
| In every other case | The plan's own rate of the value covered, neither raised nor lowered |

**Reading the schedule.** The two conditions are read in the order given. The loading of 1.00 percentage point
turns on one or more instalments refused by the payment method on the covered holding's Season Pass Programme
account within the season, together with the plan standing in any condition other than out of force for
non-payment. The relief of 0.75 of a percentage point turns on the covered holding's account carrying no
refused instalment at all in the season and on the plan carrying no payout at all for the season; one refused
instalment, or one payout already made, is enough to take the relief away.

**Condition table (hypothetical inputs).**

| Refused instalments on the covered holding's account this season | Payouts on the plan this season | The plan stands out of force for non-payment | Rate worked out at |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2 | 0 | No | The plan's rate raised by 1.00 percentage point |
| 2 | 0 | Yes | The plan's own rate |
| 0 | 0 | No | The plan's rate lowered by 0.75 of a percentage point |
| 0 | 1 | No | The plan's own rate |
| 1 | 1 | No | The plan's rate raised by 1.00 percentage point |

**Worked figure (hypothetical inputs).** On a plan whose own rate of the value covered is 6.50 per cent, the
loading brings the rate to 7.50 per cent and the relief brings it to 5.75 per cent.
